name: Dai Sengoku Rance
source:
A large-scale expansion of the main Sengoku Rance story, approved by AliceSoft, expanding the [spoiler]JAPAN unification[/spoiler] storyline and allows further exploration to the continental map and play-trough of Part 2.

The events in this mod progresses with characters who are not supposed to be in the game regardless of the routes taken in the main story. This also applies to generals who have [spoiler]disappeared due to death or dismissal[/spoiler].

Important changes and additions:
-The "Combination System", which allows generals to join forces and fight together.
-The "Blitzkrieg Warfare System", which enables blitzkrieg invasions of enemy countries.
-No use of action power for national power development in the second part.
-Changes to the labyrinth system in the second part.

-Changed game resolution from 4:3 to 16:9.
-Batch whole attack, increased battle speed.
-Replenishment of generals' troops by SHIFT+click.

[Based on the [url=https://hannylaboratory.blogspot.com/2023/11/blog-post_30.html]official website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ec_zer]Twitter[/url]]
translation:
主要战国兰斯故事的大规模扩展，经AliceSoft批准，扩展了[spoiler]日本统一[/spoiler]故事情节，并允许进一步探索第2部分的大陆地图和游戏槽。

无论主要故事采取什么路线，该模组中的事件都会与不应该出现在游戏中的角色一起进行。这也适用于拥有[spoiler]因死亡或解雇而失踪[/spoiler]。

重要变更和补充：
-“组合系统”，让武将联手作战。
-“闪电战系统”，可以对敌国进行闪电战入侵。
-第二部分没有使用行动力来发展国家力量。
-第二部分迷宫系统的变化。

-将游戏分辨率从4:3更改为16:9。
-批量整体攻击，提高战斗速度。
-通过SHIFT+点击补充将军部队。

[基于[url=https://hannylaboratory.blogspot.com/2023/11/blog-post_30.html]官方网站[/url]和[url=https://twitter.com/ec_zer]叽叽喳喳[/url]]
